summary: A fair daily now that brands count for their group (Kia finds Hyundai, Jeep finds Stellantis, Volvo finds Geely). Tesla, BMW and Mercedes will cost lives early, and most players land around 6 to 8.
reasons: Casual found 8/10 (Toyota, Ford, Honda, VW, Hyundai, GM, BYD, Stellantis via Jeep). Lives went on Tesla, BMW, Mercedes, Nissan (#13) and Ferrari. Kia, Chevrolet, Audi and Porsche were free repeats.

Old fixes checked: brand-to-group mapping is done (all 30 brands tested map right), 'chevy' now finds GM, and the listed junk aliases are gone. Still open: misses past #15 show no number, so Tesla, BMW and Mercedes read as flat misses, not near ones.
Good reveals: BYD and SAIC outsold Ford, Volvo counts for Geely, Tesla is not top 10. Fan got 9/10 and ran out of lives in the 3.0M to 3.5M pack (Suzuki #12, Nissan #13). 2025 values look right.
fixes: Rank the next groups with 2025 values so the most common misses show a number: BMW Group (about 2.5M), Renault Group (about 2.3M), Mercedes-Benz Group (about 2.2M), Tesla (about 1.6M), and if a source has them Great Wall, Tata Motors, Mazda, Mitsubishi, Subaru. Ranks 11+ still stop at #15 (Chery).

Merge duplicate unranked entries so one company can't cost two lives: 'Mercedes' and 'Mercedes-Benz' (add 'Benz'), 'Tata' and 'Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles' (add Jaguar, Land Rover); also map Mini and Rolls-Royce to BMW.

Natural spellings not recognized: 'kia motors' (add 'Kia Motors' to Hyundai Motor Group); 'tesla motors' (add 'Tesla' and 'Tesla Motors' to Tesla, Inc., which plain 'tesla' only reaches through a did-you-mean).

Leftover aliases that are not names of the group (harmless, all contain the brand): Honda 'The Power of Dreams', 'Honda Clio', 'Honda Primo', 'Honda Verno', 'Honda Outboard', 'Honda Marine Group'; Ford 'Built Ford Tough', 'Ford Research and Innovation Center', 'Ford Advanced Vehicles'; VW 'New Auto', 'Volkswagen Financial Services', 'Volkswagen Financial Services AG'; Toyota 'Toyota Financial Services', 'Toyota FTAC', 'Toyota Baltic'; BYD 'BYD Toyota EV Technology', 'GAC BYD', 'BYD TianShen', 'BYD Dual Mode'; Geely 'Geely GC2', 'Geely-Kandi Panda'; GM 'General Motors in motorsport'.
